summary: Full-extraction pass over one stored Egyptian document, Law 173/2018 (law-firm transcription of the Gazette text). Its only number (EGP 7 million deposit) and its rules (5 consecutive years' residence before naturalisation by the Interior Minister; deposit passes to the Treasury on naturalisation; in force the day after publication) are already in the data as term t-30e8d343de and event e-5f23bfc145. No new rows.

ledger.contains: Text of Law 173/2018 (Official Gazette No. 32 bis (b), 14 Aug 2018) as transcribed by an Egyptian law firm's website, in four articles: Art. 1 replaces Art. 17 of Law 89/1960 to add a fourth residence category, 'deposit residence'; Art. 2 adds Art. 20 bis defining it (foreigners coming to invest who deposit at least EGP 7 million, or the foreign-currency equivalent set by PM decree, in an Egyptian bank; conditions, duration, deposit rules, banks and investment fields to be set by Interior Minister decree after Cabinet approval); Art. 3 adds Art. 4 bis to Nationality Law 26/1975 (Interior Minister may naturalise a deposit-residence foreigner after 5 consecutive years' residence before applying, if conditions 1-3 of Art. 4(4) are met; the deposit then passes to the Treasury; Art. 9 restrictions apply; application rules by Interior Minister decree); Art. 4 in force the day after publication. Rest of the page is the law firm's menus. The one image is the firm's logo (no text to OCR). No counts or fees. The EGP 7 million minimum is already term t-30e8d343de (whose notes carry the 5-year and Treasury rules) and the publication/entry into force is event e-5f23bfc145; nothing further in scope. No naturalised persons named.
